newsitem.title: USA: Baron shares to be sold in "orderly fashion".
newsitem.headline: Baron shares to be sold in "orderly fashion".

text.p: Shares owned by A.R. Baron and Co Inc in three companies will be disposed of by a bankruptcy-court appointed trustee in "an orderly fashion", an attorney for the trustee said Wednesday.
Richard Siegel said liquidation of the assets will be carried out in order to maximize the value realized for Baron's estate.
Siegel is an attorney for trustee, James Giddens, who was tapped to oversee the sale of securities held by Baron, a New York brokerage firm.
New York based Baron had filed for bankruptcy protection in July after the Securities and Exchange Commission accused it of sales fraud.
Siegel pointed out the aggregate shares to be sold in each of three companies consisted of both proprietary shares and pledged shares.
In a filing with the SEC, the trustee said Baron held a 12 percent stake in The Jockey Club, 19.9 percent in Innovir Laboratories Inc and 32.5 percent in Paperclip Imaging Software Inc.
